pages.text: J: ascended full set spends 1000 energy on a domain. G: 150 energy for 50 shield. K: edit compact HUD. Right-click switches sword mode. Default HUD: one small bottom-left panel with mode, energy, shields and mastery level. Domains use potion icons without a separate timer. Critical calculations remain; custom crit numbers, sounds, particles and special wave appearance are disabled.
